correctness.rationale: The path matching recurrence, invariant-matching factorization, orientation sign in the simplicial Lefschetz trace, and parity simplification were reconstructed algebraically for all \(n\ge2\) and \(k\ge1\). Direct exhaustive checks for \(n=2,3\) and \(m=4,5,7,8\) reproduce every class character predicted by the formula.

value.rationale: The symmetric-group blade action is canonical after a common blade coordinate is chosen. The formula upgrades an infinite-family Betti-number result to an explicit equivariant decomposition, including a nontrivial parity twist and two copies of the standard representation in the \(2n-1\)-dimensional case. This information is not recoverable from the wedge count alone and is naturally reusable in equivariant or quotient questions.
